title: Goal simplification with simp
summary: Normalize list length expressions using targeted @[simp] lemmas.
code: theorem list_append_len (xs ys : List Nat) : (xs ++ ys).length = ys.length + xs.length := by
triggers: normalize algebraic or container expressions using rewrite rules
supply extra lemmas like Nat.add_comm to simp
prompts: Prove that (xs ++ ys).length equals ys.length + xs.length.
Simplify a list length goal and commute addition in a single simp call.
invariant: simp rewrites the goal using @[simp] lemmas plus any explicitly listed lemmas.
mantra: Feed simp the exact bridge lemmas it lacks instead of rewriting step by step.
pitfalls: Bare simp without Nat.add_comm stops at xs.length + ys.length.
Adding non-terminating rewrite rules to simp can cause a maxHeartbeats loop.

anchors.name: Targeted simp
anchors.trick: Pass List.length_append and Nat.add_comm directly inside simp [...].

mutations.explanation: Without Nat.add_comm, xs.length + ys.length does not match ys.length + xs.length.
